Supplies shall be ordered on an as-and-when-required bas is through Release Orders/Purchase Orders, and payment shall be made only for quantities actually supplied and acc epted. Bidders shall quote for the full indicated quantity against each line item, including GST. Rates shall include packing, forwarding, freight, transportation, loading, unloading, transit insurance and delivery at HPCL Koc hi LPG Plant. No additional claim on these accounts shall be entertained. TECHNICAL COMPLIANCE All offered items shall strictly comply with the minimum technical specifications in Annexure 5 - Schedule of Quantities & Specifications. Materials shall be new, unused, free from defects, suitable for industrial LPG installation use, manufacture d to the applicable IS/UL/FM/TAC/OISD/EN standards wherever specified, supplied with all required accesso ries, and delivered in original manufacturer packing. HPCL may call for physical samples during technical evaluation or before bulk supply. Where sample verific ation is required, bulk supply shall commence only after HPCL approval. Deployment Period: Within fifteen (15) days from the date of Release Order or written advice from HPCL ad vising commencement, whichever is earlier. Delivery Period: Within fifteen (15) days from the date of placement of Release Order or email communicat ion from the Plant, whichever is earlier. Bids received without EMD or a valid appl icable exemption document are liable for rejection. Security Deposit: Two percent (2%) of total Purchase Order value, to be submitted within fifteen (15) days from LOI/PO as provided in the tender. Performance Bank Guarantee: Five percent (5%) of PO value, as provided in the tender. Payment Terms: 100% of the billed amount shall be paid within fifteen (15) days from receipt of the bill by HPCL with all supporting documents, subject to submission of the e-payment mandate and acceptance of s

upplied material. No advance payment shall be made with the order or against dispatch documents through the bank. INSPECTION, DOCUMENTATION AND WARRANT Y HPCL reserves the right to inspect materials at the manufacturer’s works, supplier premises or HPCL Kochi LPG Plant. Materials not conforming to approved specifications, samples, standards or certificates may be rejected. The supplier shall submit, wherever applicable: invoice, delivery challan, manufacturer test certificate, cali bration certificate, warranty certificate, BIS/ISI certificate, UL/FM/TAC approval, PESO approval, product dat asheet, user manual, inspection certificates, item-wise packing details and any other document requested by HPCL. Rejected, damaged, defective or non-conforming material shall be replaced at no additional cost to HPCL. I nferior-quality material shall be replaced within fourteen (14) days; failure may attract recovery of materia l cost plus ten percent additional penalty as stated in the tender. Applicable OEM warranty shall be passed on to HPCL. Items found defective during the applicable warranty period shall be repaired or replaced at no additional cost. DELAY, FIRM PRICE AND OTHER CONDITIONS For delayed supply, price reduction/penalty shall apply at 0.5% of the basic value of the delayed/undeliver ed portion for every week or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 5%, with pro-rata application for fractio nal days as provided in the tender. Prices shall remain firm during the contract period, and no escalation/de-escalation or price revision shall b e entertained. The bidder shall visit HPCL Kochi LPG Plant at its own cost to understand the scope and site conditions bef ore submission of the bid. Any representation arising from incomplete understanding shall not be entertain ed. Bidders shall go through the complete tender document and upload all mandated declarations and docum ents. Scope, detailed specifications, payment documentation and all other terms and conditions are contai ned in the tender attachments. HPCL terms and conditions shall supersede in case of conflict. Note: Open tender attachments using the latest version of Adobe Acrobat for proper viewing. Contradiction : Wherever there is a contradiction in various parameters of scope of job, technical sp ecifications or special/general terms & conditions, the same shall be clarified with the contact person/officer in charge through queries, prior to the submission of bid.
